【原视频简介】
Does the science in Dr. STONE actually work in the real world, or is it just anime exaggeration? In this video, we put Senku’s recipes to the test in real life!

We kick off Season 1 by replicating 4 iconic experiments from the anime using real lab equipment and chemicals. From basic survival essentials to vibrant chemical reactions, let's find out if anime science holds up in real life!

00:46 - Experiment 1: Salt Extraction (Episode 1)
02:16 - Experiment 2: Making Bar Soap (Episode 2)
04:23 - Experiment 3: Accelerated Copper Oxidation (Episode 3)
06:00 - Experiment 4: The Colorful Flame Test "Magic" (Episode 7)

All experiments were conducted under controlled conditions with proper lab safety gear (PPE). Chemical reactions involving strong bases, oxidizers, and open flames should not be attempted without appropriate safety precautions and supervision.

Which Dr. STONE invention should we test next in Part 2? let me know in the comments below!

Don't forget to Like, Share, and Subscribe for more real-world anime science experiments!
